title: Regular system of parameters
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and Krull dimension $d$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. An ordered finite list $t=(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$ is a regular system of parameters if $r=d$ and $(t_1,\ldots,t_r)=\mathfrak m$; thus $R$ is regular local in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme]. The empty list is permitted when $d=0$.
